thema: "Free" AI tools fact-checked: what the free plans really include
idee_original: Faktencheck eines viralen TikToks ("10 beste kostenlose KI-Tools"): viele sind nur teilweise kostenlos.
rechercheauftrag: Nur die hinterlegten offiziellen Preisseiten (Stand 09.10.2026) verwenden. Fremdes Video nicht nennen oder zitieren.

quellen.name: Looka (AI logo maker)
quellen.text: "It's totally free to make logos. Only pay when you're happy!" Basic Logo Package: one low-res PNG file, $35 one-time purchase. Premium Logo Package: multiple high-res file types, $72 one-time purchase. Brand Kit Subscription: $96 per year. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)

quellen.name: Leonardo.Ai (image generator)
quellen.text: Free plan: $0 per month, 150 fast tokens per day, creations access: Public. Essential plan: $12 per month, creations access: Private. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)

quellen.name: Gamma (AI presentations)
quellen.text: Free plan: 400 credits at signup, create up to 10 slides per prompt. Plus plan adds 1,000 monthly credits and removes Gamma branding. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)

quellen.name: Suno (AI music)
quellen.text: Free plan: 50 credits per day, no monthly song downloads, no commercial rights. Pro plan: 2,500 credits per month, commercial use rights. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)

quellen.name: ElevenLabs (AI voice)
quellen.text: Free plan: $0 per month, 10k credits per month, text to speech. Commercial License and Instant Voice Cloning start with the paid Starter plan. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)

quellen.name: Notta (AI transcription)
quellen.text: Free plan: 120 transcription minutes per month, up to 3 minutes per conversation. Pro plan: 1,800 minutes per month. (Official page read on October 9, 2026.)
